title: 未熄（短片）
concept: 人类的赞歌是勇气的赞歌；ANET 是具身智能与人类智能的团结。
logline: MOSS 判了地球死刑并沉默。一个没见过太阳的少年、一台报废的维修机器人，和一群凡人，把手伸向了彼此。

shots.video: 微距固定镜头。黑暗里，一台旧打印机一格一格地吐出纸带，最后盖上一枚红色小印，纸带垂下来轻轻晃。环境声：打印头的哒哒声，然后安静。
shots.vo: 这是一台维修机器人留下的最后一条记录。

dialogue.line: 接进来。全城的眼睛，都接进来。

tpl.soundscape: plug clicking into the port, footsteps on the hall floor

tpl.summary: In the command hall, the giant wall screen relights with a rough map of thousands of scattered dots, and the operators rise to their feet one by one.

tpl.blur: deep focus, with the whole hall and the dotted screen wall kept sharp
tpl.soundscape: a low, collective sound of breaths being drawn in

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: old Boye in the dim interview room, both hands spread flat as if laying things on a table.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷两只手摊开，像是把东西一样样摆在桌上，慢而笃定地说。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 没有谁看得见全部。可每个人看见的那一小块，摆到一张桌上，就是一张图。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, old Boye slowly and firmly lays out his point with open hands, opening with "没有谁看得见全部。" and ending on "摆到一张桌上，就是一张图。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye sits at frame centre in medium close-up, both hands spread flat in the lower foreground, the dim interview room softly receding behind him, nothing at frame left or right.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Boye sits settled with both hands raised in front of his chest, palms beginning to open outward.
tpl.middle: He spreads both hands flat and apart, slowly setting them down one after another as if placing objects on a table.
tpl.end: His hands rest open and level in the lower frame, his gaze steady and assured, body still.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, Boye and his hands sharp, the dim room background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum of a still indoor space

shots.frame: Beside a huge truck in blowing snow: Boss Jin and Amu lift a rugged steel case, open for a moment to show the ember-red glowing igniter core, up into the cab.
shots.video: 手持镜头，风雪里。金老板和阿牧合力把一只钢箱抬上驾驶室，箱盖合上前，里面的点火核心泛着暗红的光。环境声：风声、引擎怠速。

dialogue.line: 火石上车。四十公里，冰上走。

tpl.summary: Beside a huge truck in blowing snow, Boss Jin and Amu lift a steel case holding the glowing igniter core up into the cab; the clip opens and ends on the line "火石上车。四十公里，冰上走。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin at frame left and Amu at frame right share the steel case at centre, the huge truck fills the background, and blowing snow streaks through the foreground.

tpl.start: Boss Jin and Amu brace in the snow, gripping the rugged steel case between them beside the truck's cab step.
tpl.middle: They heave the case upward together, and the lid shows the ember-red igniter core glowing for a moment before closing.
tpl.end: The closed case is pushed up into the cab as both men steady their footing against the wind.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, snow flakes in the foreground and the truck's far body soft, focus on the case and the two men's hands.
tpl.soundscape: howling wind, idling truck engine

shots.frame: At the tail ramp of a truck in the snow, Xiaoman pushes the small yellow robot with the glowing smiley screen up the ramp, his breath fogging.
shots.video: 手持镜头。小满推着“螺丝”上了车尾的跳板，机器人的履带在冰上打了一下滑，他用肩膀顶住。环境声：履带声、风声。

tpl.summary: In the snow at the tail ramp of a truck, Xiaoman pushes the small yellow robot Luosi up the ramp, and its tracks slip on the ice before he braces it with his shoulder.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman at frame centre-left behind the robot, Luosi at frame centre on the ramp with its smiley screen glowing, truck tail at right and background, snowy ground in the foreground.

tpl.start: Xiaoman leans forward with both hands on Luosi's back and starts pushing the robot up the truck's tail ramp, his breath fogging in the cold air.
tpl.middle: Luosi's tracks slip on the icy ramp and the robot lurches sideways, and Xiaoman shifts his weight to catch it.
tpl.end: Xiaoman braces his shoulder against Luosi, holding it steady on the ramp, and the robot's smiley screen keeps glowing.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, with the snowy background and truck interior softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: rolling tracks scraping on ice, wind

shots.frame: Wide shot: twelve heavy trucks roll out in a line across the ice plain under the vast orange glow of Jupiter, headlights tiny.
shots.video: 固定大远景。十二台重型运输车排成一线，开进木星的橘红色光里，车灯小得像火星。环境声：引擎的合鸣、风声。
shots.vo: 饱和式救援。每一台停机的发动机，都有车队在赶去。

tpl.summary: Twelve heavy trucks drive in a single line across an icy plain toward the vast orange glow of Jupiter, their headlights tiny as sparks; there is no dialogue.

tpl.start: The convoy's lead trucks enter the frame as a line of small dark shapes with tiny headlights on the ice plain.
tpl.middle: The line of twelve trucks keeps rolling steadily forward across the ice, headlights glinting like sparks against the orange light.
tpl.end: The trucks advance deeper into Jupiter's orange glow, the whole line still visible and shrinking against the vast landscape.
tpl.blur: deep focus with everything sharp, slight atmospheric haze softening the distant horizon and the glow of Jupiter
tpl.soundscape: combined low drone of many engines, wind blowing across the open ice

shots.frame: Inside the shaking cab: the node box on the dashboard flashes its lamps, Boss Jin hauls the wheel hard to the left, orange light through the windscreen.
shots.video: 剧烈晃动的驾驶室内镜头。仪表台上的铁盒急促地闪灯，金老板猛打方向盘向左，整个人被甩得一歪。环境声：急促的提示音、引擎嘶吼。

dialogue.line: 前面裂了！它让我们往左！

tpl.summary: Inside a violently shaking convoy cab, Boss Jin wrenches the wheel left as the dashboard node box flashes; the clip opens and ends on his line "前面裂了！它让我们往左！"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin at frame centre-right gripping the steering wheel, node box with flashing lamps on the dashboard at frame left foreground, windscreen with orange light filling the background.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld inside the cab with strong violent shake
tpl.start: The node box on the dashboard blinks its lamps rapidly while Boss Jin grips the wheel, the cab already rattling.
tpl.middle: Boss Jin hauls the steering wheel hard to the left, his whole body thrown sideways by the lurch.
tpl.end: Boss Jin braces against the wheel, held in the leftward turn, as the node box keeps flashing and orange light sweeps the cab.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, Jin and node box sharp, windscreen scenery behind them blurred into orange glare.
tpl.soundscape: rapid alert beeps, roaring engine, rattling cab

shots.frame: Long-lens shot: a crevasse splits the ice behind the convoy and the last truck's headlights tilt, drop and vanish into a cloud of snow.
shots.video: 长焦镜头，晃动。车队后方的冰面裂开，最后一台车的车灯一歪，沉下去，消失在腾起的雪雾里。环境声：冰层断裂的巨响。

tpl.summary: On the ice field behind the convoy, a crevasse splits open and the last truck tips into it, its headlights vanishing in a cloud of snow; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the crevasse and the last truck sit at frame centre in the background, the convoy's rear lies at frame left and right in the mid-ground, and open ice fills the foreground.

tpl.middle: The last truck's headlights tilt sideways and drop as the ice gives way beneath it.
tpl.end: The headlights sink out of sight and a billowing cloud of snow rises over the gap.
tpl.blur: Compressed long-lens depth with a soft, hazy background, and snow mist partly obscuring the sinking truck.
tpl.soundscape: massive cracking and splitting of ice, rumbling of collapsing ice sheets, hissing snow spray

shots.frame: Tight close-up of Boss Jin gripping a radio handset in the cab, eyes fixed on the mirror, orange light on his scarred cheek.
shots.video: 手持特写。金老板死死攥着对讲机，盯着后视镜，对着话筒喊。对讲机里只有电流声。环境声：电流杂音、引擎声。

dialogue.line: 七号车！老秦！回话！

tpl.summary: Inside the convoy cab, Boss Jin grips a radio handset and stares into the rear-view mirror, calling out for a response that never comes; the clip opens and ends on his line "七号车！老秦！回话！" with only static answering.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin fills the centre of frame in the cab, handset raised at frame right near his mouth, rear-view mirror at upper frame left, orange light falling on his scarred cheek, blurred cab interior behind him.
tpl.camera: tight close-up, handheld with a slight tense shake
tpl.start: Boss Jin holds the radio handset tightly in his fist, his eyes locked on the rear-view mirror.
tpl.middle: He pulls the handset closer to his mouth and leans toward it, his jaw and knuckles tightening as he calls into it.
tpl.end: He lowers the handset slightly but keeps staring at the mirror, his grip still white-knuckled as only static comes back.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, cab interior and windshield background softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: radio static crackle, engine hum

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Boss Jin sits in the dim interview room, a walking cane across his knees, eyes wet, looking past the lens.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。金老板膝上横着一根拐杖，眼眶是红的，望着镜头外，说得很慢，说完抹了一把脸。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 十二台车出去，八台到。老秦没到。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Boss Jin sits with a cane across his knees and looks past the lens; the clip opens and ends on the line "十二台车出去，八台到。老秦没到。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin sits at frame centre in the dim interview room, cane lying across his knees in the lower foreground, empty dark room behind him.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Boss Jin sits still with the cane across his knees, red-rimmed eyes fixed on a point beyond the lens.
tpl.middle: He keeps his gaze off-camera, his posture heavy and unmoving, his wet eyes catching the dim light.
tpl.end: He raises one hand and wipes it slowly across his face, then lowers it back to the cane.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, Boss Jin sharp, dim room background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Wide shot at the foot of the dark, dead planetary engine under Jupiter's glow: a steel relay mast buckles and falls as ice and concrete slide down over a shaft opening.
shots.video: 固定远景，画面震动。停机的发动机脚下，一根中继桅杆折断倒下，冰块和混凝土滑下来，埋住了井口。环境声：坍塌的轰响。

tpl.summary: At the foot of the dark, dead planetary engine under Jupiter's glow, a steel relay mast snaps and falls, and sliding ice and concrete bury the shaft opening; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the dead planetary engine looms in the background and upper frame, the relay mast stands at frame left-centre, and the shaft opening lies at lower centre, where debris slides in from the right.

tpl.start: The steel relay mast at the foot of the dark engine trembles and begins to buckle as the ground shakes.
tpl.middle: The mast snaps and topples sideways while chunks of ice and concrete break loose and slide down the slope.
tpl.end: The sliding debris piles up and completely buries the shaft opening, leaving dust and settling rubble.
tpl.blur: deep focus, with the whole wide frame sharp and only dust and falling debris slightly blurred by motion
tpl.soundscape: deep rumbling roar of the collapse, grinding concrete, cracking ice, groaning twisted steel

shots.frame: At the rubble-choked mouth of a relay shaft: Amu crouches with a node box in his hands, its lamps dark, Xiaoman beside him, wind and snow.
shots.video: 手持镜头。被碎石堵住的井口边，阿牧蹲着，手里的节点盒灯全灭了。他抬头看了一眼发动机，对小满说。环境声：风声、碎石滚落声。

dialogue.line: 中继断了。下面听不见我们。

tpl.summary: At the rubble-choked mouth of a relay shaft in wind and snow, Amu crouches with a dead node box and tells Xiaoman the relay is down; the clip opens and ends on the line "中继断了。下面听不见我们。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu crouches at frame centre holding the node box, Xiaoman beside him at frame right, the rubble-choked shaft mouth in the foreground, wind-blown snow in the background.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld with a slight natural shake
tpl.start: Amu crouches at the shaft mouth, looking down at the node box in his hands, all its lamps dark.
tpl.middle: He lifts his head and glances toward the engine, the dead node box still held in his hands.
tpl.end: He turns his gaze to Xiaoman beside him and holds still, the box lowered in his hands.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; falling snow and the distant engine are soft, Amu and the node box stay sharp.
tpl.soundscape: wind, rubble rolling and falling

shots.frame: Low shot: the small yellow robot with the glowing smiley turns on its tracks to face a narrow black gap between fallen concrete slabs; Xiaoman, behind it, turning his head as he realises.
shots.video: 低机位手持。“螺丝”原地转过身，屏幕对着碎石间一道漆黑的窄缝，停住了。身后的小满慢慢转过头，明白了它要做什么。环境声：电机转动声、风声。

tpl.summary: Among fallen concrete rubble, the small yellow robot Luosi turns in place to face a narrow black gap between slabs and stops, while Xiaoman behind it slowly turns his head and realises what it intends to do.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Luosi at frame centre-left in the foreground, its smiley screen facing the dark gap at frame right; Xiaoman behind it in the background, centre, head turning toward the robot; broken concrete slabs fill the surroundings.

tpl.start: Luosi pivots on its tracks in place amid the rubble, turning its glowing smiley screen away from Xiaoman.
tpl.middle: Luosi finishes the turn, its screen now aimed at the narrow black gap between the broken concrete slabs, and it halts.
tpl.end: Behind the stopped robot, Xiaoman slowly turns his head toward it, his expression shifting as he understands what it means to do.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field: Luosi and the dark gap stay sharp, while Xiaoman and the rubble behind fall softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: motor whirring from the robot's tracks, wind moving through the ruins

shots.frame: Xiaoman throws both arms around the body of the small yellow robot from behind, heels dug into the ice, shouting.
shots.video: 手持镜头。小满扑上去从后面抱住“螺丝”的机身，脚跟蹬着冰面往回拽，朝它喊。环境声：履带空转的摩擦声、风声。

dialogue.line: 不行！你回来！会压碎的！

tpl.summary: On an icy expanse, Xiaoman lunges at Luosi and hauls it back by the body, opening with "不行！你回来！" and ending on "会压碎的！"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Luosi is at frame centre facing away from camera, Xiaoman directly behind it clinging to its body, open icy ground stretching behind them.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld with a slight shake, following the struggle
tpl.start: Xiaoman dives forward from behind and wraps both arms around Luosi's yellow body as its treads spin on the ice.
tpl.middle: She digs her heels into the ice and leans her whole weight backward, dragging the robot back against its pull.
tpl.end: Xiaoman stays locked around Luosi's body, braced and straining, with the treads still churning in place.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, the distant icy background soft and pale while Xiaoman and Luosi stay sharp.
tpl.soundscape: treads spinning and grinding on ice, wind

shots.frame: Close-up: the robot's glowing smiley screen turned toward Xiaoman's face; its small manipulator claw rests gently on the back of his glove.
shots.video: 特写。“螺丝”停了下来，屏幕转过来对着小满的脸。它抬起机械爪，在他的手套上轻轻碰了一下，然后松开。环境声：电机的轻响，风声忽然远了。

tpl.summary: In a close-up, the robot Luosi stops, turns its glowing smiley screen toward Xiaoman's face, and gently touches the back of his glove with its claw before letting go.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Luosi's smiley screen at frame left and centre facing right, Xiaoman's face and gloved hand at frame right, its claw resting on his glove in the foreground, blurred background behind both.
tpl.camera: close-up, locked-off camera with a very slight handheld settle
tpl.start: Luosi rolls to a halt and its glowing smiley screen turns toward Xiaoman's face.
tpl.middle: Luosi raises its small manipulator claw and lightly touches the back of Xiaoman's glove.
tpl.end: The claw releases and lifts away from the glove, leaving the screen still facing Xiaoman.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, background softly out of focus, sharp focus on the screen, claw and glove
tpl.soundscape: soft electric motor whirr, wind that suddenly seems to recede into the distance

shots.frame: From behind: the small yellow robot drives into the narrow dark gap under a tilted concrete slab, its whip antenna scraping the concrete, its glow disappearing inside.
shots.video: 手持镜头，从背后拍。“螺丝”开进了石板底下的窄缝，天线刮着混凝土，身上的光一点点没进黑暗里。环境声：履带声、金属刮擦声。

tpl.summary: Inside a ruined area, Luosi, the small yellow tracked robot, drives away from camera into the narrow dark gap under a tilted concrete slab, its antenna scraping the concrete as its glow fades into the darkness.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Luosi is at frame centre, seen from behind, facing away from camera; the tilted concrete slab fills the background and upper frame, and the dark gap is centre background; no other characters visible.

tpl.end: Luosi's body and glow gradually sink into the darkness beneath the slab until only a faint trace of light remains.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, Luosi in soft focus with the concrete edges and dark gap falling off into blur and shadow
tpl.soundscape: tracked robot treads rolling over rubble, metallic scraping of antenna against concrete

shots.frame: Inside the collapsed shaft, tight shot: the small yellow robot wedged between concrete slabs raises its antenna, dust falling through its smiley glow, a slab pressing down on its roof, a crack running across the screen.
shots.video: 狭小空间里的特写。“螺丝”卡在两块石板中间，把天线一节一节升起来。头顶的石板往下沉，屏幕上裂开一道缝，笑脸还亮着。环境声：混凝土的呻吟、电机吃力的声音。

tpl.summary: Inside a collapsed shaft, the small yellow robot Luosi, wedged between two concrete slabs, raises its antenna section by section as the slab above sinks and a crack splits its screen while the smiley face stays lit; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Luosi sits at frame centre, wedged between two concrete slabs, one above pressing on its roof and one below; its antenna rises at upper centre, and the dark, dusty shaft fills the background.

tpl.start: Luosi sits jammed between the two slabs, its smiley screen glowing, and its antenna begins to extend from the top of its body.

tpl.blur: Very shallow depth of field: the screen and antenna are sharp, while the slab edges and the shaft behind are soft and dark.
tpl.soundscape: groaning concrete, a laboring motor straining, faint dust and grit trickling

shots.frame: Close-up of the node box in Amu's gloved hands: its lamps come back on, green, one after another, snow blowing across.
shots.video: 特写。阿牧手里的节点盒，灯一颗接一颗重新亮了，绿色。他猛地抬起头喊。环境声：一串急促的提示音、风声。

dialogue.line: 通了！螺丝把自己架成了中继！

tpl.summary: In a snowy outdoor setting, Amu holds a node box whose lamps relight green one by one, then he looks up and shouts; the clip opens and ends on the single line "通了！螺丝把自己架成了中继！"

tpl.end: Amu suddenly jerks his head up from the box, mouth opening wide as he shouts.
tpl.blur: Very shallow depth of field: only the node box and its lamps are sharp, while Amu's face and the snowy background are softly blurred.
tpl.soundscape: a rapid series of electronic beeps, wind blowing

shots.frame: Handheld chase shot from behind: Amu, the steel core case on his shoulder, runs down a dark engine gallery lit by emergency lamps.

shots.frame: Xiaoman on his knees at the black gap in the rubble, both hands on the concrete, shouting into the darkness.

shots.video: 手持镜头，缓慢前移。一条长走廊的墙上，钉满了成千上万条回执纸带，被通风口的风吹得轻轻翻动。人们站在墙前，一个孩子伸手摸了摸其中一条，旁边停着一台小维修机器人。环境声：纸带的沙沙声、低声的交谈。
shots.vo: 每一份付出都被记住了。人的，和机器的。

tpl.end: The child's hand rests on the strip while the small maintenance robot stays parked beside the child, and the camera keeps drifting forward.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field: the child and nearby strips are sharp, while the far end of the corridor and distant strips soften into blur.
tpl.soundscape: soft rustling of paper strips, low murmured conversation, faint ventilation airflow

shots.frame: In the repair stall under the warm lamp: Xiaoman solders inside the open, dented body of the small yellow robot, its cracked screen dark; old Boye holds a work lamp for him.

shots.frame: Medium shot at floor level: Xiaoman, laughing through tears, holds out his open hand; the dented yellow robot with the cracked glowing smiley raises its manipulator claw and touches his palm.
shots.video: 手持低机位中景。小满又哭又笑，蹲下来伸出手掌。“螺丝”抬起机械爪，碰了碰他的手心，和第一次一样。环境声：电机声、他的笑声。

dialogue.line: 欢迎回家，螺丝。

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: old Boye in the dim interview room, glasses on, a small stubborn smile, looking straight at the interviewer.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷扶了扶眼镜，看着采访者，一句一句慢慢地说，说完笑了一下。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 勇气不是不怕。是怕，还把手伸出去。人类的赞歌，就是勇气的赞歌。连一台小机器，都懂。

shots.frame: Final shot from inside a cabin window: on the sill a small handmade node box with a smiley sticker blinks a green lamp; beyond the glass, the ice plain, the engine beams, and Jupiter shrunk to a bright point.
shots.video: 固定镜头，极缓慢推近。窗台上，一只贴着笑脸的小铁盒一下一下闪着绿灯。窗外是冰原、发动机的光柱，和已经缩成一个亮点的木星。环境声：平稳的轰鸣，小灯的提示音。
shots.vo: 路还有两千五百年。灯还亮着。
